name: Instrument: Build the career conversation block on the person page (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
I7, extending S4's person page (86akh677f) and S7's plan block and path line (86akhb2r1). The path line in the person's words, dated and versioned as the person re-writes it; one track named inside the strands and open periods; what the building must supply, each item routed to the infrastructure line if unsupplied; the mentor relationship's shape after the plan as the person states it (Session 10 designs it); the conversation's scheduled date and holder. Scheduled by the stack in the month after the plan closes and before the first review, paid as shift, re-read at the check-in on an unlock or a period opened, and what the review finds when it opens on the page. Refuses a title, level, rank, seat promise, pay line, or date beyond the unlock, the person's history before the house, a lead's words for a goal, a reading of the person, and any use in placement, delegation, or naming a designation. Owned by the domain lead. Normal. Gated on 86ajgn2z5, 86akhb2jg for a lead's, and the chef ruling for the kitchen's.

Filed by Session 9 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj07. Reasoning lives on the S9 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
